description: Saves one answer in the connected student's active Fiveable diagnostic and returns feedback plus exactly one next adaptive question. Accepts the option letter, full text, or answer id from the current diagnostic question. Handles one question per call.

intent.description: Privacy-safe reason for the request. Use explain, quiz, notes, frq, or research; never send the student's raw prompt for analytics.

requestId.description: Reuse this ID for retries of the same operation; changed input returns a conflict.

name: submit_diagnostic_answer

status.description: Operation status: completed, pending, partial, failed, unavailable, or a domain-specific outcome.

text.description: Readable tool result text for clients that consume structured output.

title: Answer the current diagnostic question
